name: ComputerDefaults.exe
description: ComputerDefaults.exe is a Windows system utility for managing default applications for tasks like web browsing, emailing, and media playback.
author: Eron Clarke

commands.description: Upon execution, ComputerDefaults.exe checks two registry values at HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\ms-settings\Shell\open\command; if these are set by an attacker, the set command will be executed as a high-integrity process without a UAC prompt being displayed to the user. See 'resources' for which registry keys/values to set.
commands.usecase: Execute a binary or script as a high-integrity process without a UAC prompt.

detection: A binary or script spawned as a child process of ComputerDefaults.exe
